purpose: Embed a yes-or-no uncertainty inside a sentence.
keywords: Plain clause + かどうか; nouns and な-adjectives omit だ.
I do not yet know whether I can go tomorrow.
I will check whether the shop is open.
Please check whether this is genuine.
formation: Plain clause + かどうか; nouns and な-adjectives omit だ.
restrictions: The surrounding predicate often concerns knowing, checking, or deciding.
mistake: Use a question word + か without どうか for ordinary embedded who/where questions.
